A growing share of our collections use materials with a lower footprint than industry-standard options: organic cotton, for example, can use up to 70% less water and around 20% less energy than conventional cotton, while recycled polyester can cut energy use by as much as 45% and reduce carbon emissions by around 30% compared with virgin polyester.
